name: Llocnou de Sant Jeroni (Spain)
description: Red field charged at the centre with the uncrowned arms of Llocnou de Sant Jeroni (fleurs-de-lis on blue, a lion on blue and the bars of Aragon).
history: The official flag of Llocnou de Sant Jeroni is of proportions 2:3, red, with the municipal arms without a crown at the centre, occupying three fifths of the height of the cloth; it was approved by resolution of 5 July 2017 of the Presidency of the Generalitat and published in the DOGV of 8 August 2017. The arms had been approved by resolution of 6 September 1994.

features.role: Llocnou de Sant Jeroni arms without a crown — fleurs-de-lis on blue, a lion beneath a hat on blue and the bars of Aragon
